# A split line on a payment that settles in the record's own currency.
#
# The splits a payment block carries are consumed by the cross-currency
# settlement, which is what has a realized difference for them to take. This
# invoice is CAD and is paid from a CAD bank, so that path never runs — and a
# bank fee written here has nothing to place it.
#
# What this fixture produces: the import is refused, naming the fee split and
# saying why it cannot be honoured. Accepting the file and dropping the fee
# would be the failure Q-035 was filed against — an import that exits 0, prints
# a success summary, and leaves the book missing what the file stated.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_payment_split_must_be_consumed.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Bank Fees
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-CAD"
	name: "Domestic Customer"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-CAD-FEE"
	customer_id: "C-CAD"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-CAD-FEE"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Payment for INV-CAD-FEE"
		Expenses:Bank Fees 2.00 CAD
